definitions.explanation: Without any delay or hesitation; right away. Most commonly used in the adverbial form {即座|そくざ}に.

examples.japanese: {即座|そくざ}に{返事|へんじ}をした。
{彼|かれ}は{質問|しつもん}に{即座|そくざ}に{答|こた}えた。
examples.english: He answered the question on the spot.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}が{発覚|はっかく}し、{即座|そくざ}に{対策|たいさく}が{取|と}られた。
examples.english: The problem was discovered, and countermeasures were immediately taken.

notes:
Almost always used in the adverbial form {即座|そくざ}に. Conveys a sense of decisiveness and lack of hesitation. More formal than すぐに.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即座|そくざ}に{対応|たいおう}する — to respond immediately
- {即座|そくざ}に{判断|はんだん}する — to judge instantly
- {即座|そくざ}に{答|こた}える — to answer on the spot
- {即座|そくざ}に{行動|こうどう}する — to act immediately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- すぐに — right away (everyday)
- {直|ただ}ちに — immediately (formal, often for orders/instructions)
- {瞬時|しゅんじ}に — in an instant (emphasizes speed)
